The Way of the Warrior

Where ancient samurai principles meet the modern path of Aikido

Discipline. Honor. Strength.

At Mumei Shudan, we embrace the fierce elegance of the samurai spirit combined with Aikido's philosophy of harmony. Our training forges warriors who walk the path with unwavering discipline while maintaining respect for all beings.

  • Develop unshakeable mental fortitude and focus
  • Master techniques rooted in samurai combat arts
  • Cultivate the warrior's spirit through dedicated practice
  • Join a brotherhood bound by honor and mutual growth

Our Philosophy

Our dojo follows the teachings of O-Sensei Morihei Ueshiba, the founder of Aikido, through the guidance of the Aikikai Foundation. We maintain traditional values while making the art accessible to modern practitioners.

Under the guidance of Serge Beraud Sensei (6th Dan), our practice emphasizes:

  • Respect and humility in training
  • Continuous personal development
  • The integration of body, mind, and spirit
  • Community and mutual support
